patch:
diff --git a/spec/scripts/worktree-include.sh b/spec/scripts/worktree-include.sh
index 7b2cf72..fd7c0fe 100755
--- a/spec/scripts/worktree-include.sh
+++ b/spec/scripts/worktree-include.sh
@@ -48,7 +48,7 @@ git -C "$ROOT" rev-parse --git-dir >/dev/null 2>&1 || die "--root '$ROOT' is not
 INCLUDES=""
 if [ -f "$ROOT/.worktreeinclude" ]; then
   INCLUDES="$(cd "$ROOT" && git ls-files -oi --exclude-from=.worktreeinclude \
-    | grep -v '^\.claude/worktrees/' | git check-ignore --stdin 2>/dev/null)"
+    | grep -v '^\.claude/worktrees/')"
 fi
 
 if [ -n "$INCLUDES" ]; then

survivors.claim: worktree-include.sh drops the `| git check-ignore --stdin` stage that D1, the Contracts block, A2 and the base merge-back.sh inline block all carry, so it copies any manifest-matched UNTRACKED file, not only the gitignored ones — a selection-rule change on both worktree paths that no AC-1..5 test pins.
survivors.impact: A file listed in the manifest but merely untracked rather than ignored now lands in every build worktree and every replay scratch worktree; the build worktree path silently changed behavior though the spec promised it preserved.
survivors.evidence: Spec D1: enumerates files that are BOTH gitignored AND matched; Contracts: selection pipeline ends in `| git check-ignore --stdin`; base merge-back.sh via git show 9406d14e carries it. Violating hunk worktree-include.sh:50-51 has no check-ignore. Executed repro (scratch host: .gitignore=.env, .worktreeinclude=.env+notes.txt, notes.txt untracked NOT ignored): `bash spec/scripts/worktree-include.sh --root R --dest D` → stderr `copied 2`, dest contains .env and notes.txt; the Contracts pipeline yields .env only.
